2026_01_ATL_PIT.headline: Atlanta’s backup-quarterback plan meets Pittsburgh’s pressure-heavy opener
2026_01_ATL_PIT.paragraph1: Atlanta is starting Cooper Rush with Tua Tagovailoa and Michael Penix Jr. inactive, putting extra weight on Bijan Robinson and clean protection against Pittsburgh’s edge rush. The Steelers enter comparatively healthy and can dictate the game if T.J. Watt and company create long-yardage situations. Atlanta must stay efficient on early downs and use Robinson as both runner and outlet, while Pittsburgh’s offense needs to avoid giving the Falcons short fields.
2026_01_ATL_PIT.model_rationale: Pittsburgh can make Atlanta’s quarterback limitations more costly by controlling passing downs, while the Falcons need Robinson and manageable situations to keep the game balanced.
